title: Go Beyond Time !!
description: Replay the history of the Minecraft world with a different interpretation.
body:
This mod explores a lost chapter of the Minecraft world through ancient remains and forgotten materials.

The story is not told directly. Instead, it is uncovered through **"Scrolls"**, **"Tablets"**, and **"Abandoned Cabins"** scattered across the world. Some systems are still in development, but the foundation of the lore is already in place.

In the current version, you can discover **"Blusteel"**, an ancient alloy forged from knowledge lost to time, and encounter **"Abandoned Cabins"** that hint at past catastrophes.

This mod is actively updated, and future versions will expand the story, mechanics, and interactions.
